newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Morocco, Netherlands to combat drugs, criminals.
newsitem.headline: Morocco, Netherlands to combat drugs, criminals.

text.p: Morocco's Interior Minister Driss Basri and his Dutch counterpart Hans Dijkstal said on Wednesday they plan to reinforce cooperation to combat clandestine immigration, drugs and organised crime.

"The two parties agreed to exchange information on drug networks, immigration and planned regular meetings in the Hague and Rabat to discuss the latest developmemts," a statement issued by the Moroccan interior ministry said.
Morocco has asked the Netherlands, where more than 200,000 Moroccans live, to legalise the position of those there without proper papers, the statement said.
Dijkstal also met other officials including Prime Minister Abdellatif Filali, with whom he discussed Morocco's relations with the European Union in the light of the association accord.
